error: Uncaught ReferenceError: Cannot access 'yn' before initialization

minified_variable_mapping.explanation: Production minifier renamed const EMPTY_CAPABILITIES to yn; GOVERNED_FALLBACK referenced it before const initialization (TDZ).

root_cause: GOVERNED_FALLBACK object literal (line 29-54) assigned capabilities: EMPTY_CAPABILITIES before const EMPTY_CAPABILITIES was declared (previously line 56). JavaScript temporal dead zone: const bindings are not initialized until their declaration is evaluated.
fix: Moved const EMPTY_CAPABILITIES = Object.freeze({}) above GOVERNED_FALLBACK definition.
